_doc: Core tunables for the tick simulation (GDD 2). Times are in ticks (1 tick = 0.6 s).
_damage_scale_doc: Multiplies every max hit (melee, ranged, spells). Tier-1 gear at 99 HP made fights 3-5x longer than OSRS PvP; one global factor keeps all GDD tables in proportion. See docs/DECISIONS.md.
_lab_doc: wards_enabled and freeze_mult exist so The Lab (data/mutators.json) can change them; protect_reduction defaults to prayers.json.
_matchmaking_doc: U3: casual queues group players within 'window' combat levels, widening by widen_by every widen_every_s seconds of waiting (shared/matchmaker.gd). Bots in casual matches are kept within the window too.
_balance_check_doc: U9: tests/test_balance.gd fails if any default class (own unlocks at each standard level) or bracket kit wins more than max_win_rate of its duels against the other classes (sides swapped every other duel).
_leave_cooldown_doc: Ranked queue cooldown after leaving (U5, used from U4): Nth leave inside the window -> steps[N-1] minutes (last step repeats).
_kill_credit_doc: Kill goes to the most damage dealt in this many ticks before death (50 = 30 s); ties go to the latest hitter.
